verdict.rationale: Asana documents a step-by-step 'quick start guide' for building an app and creating tasks via the API (asana-docs-1, asana-docs-14), which offers a guided path for developers integrating with Asana, but there is no evidence of a guided in-product walkthrough for setting up a workspace itself as a first-time user. missing for 10: dedicated first-run workspace setup walkthrough/onboarding flow, evidence of interactive UI onboarding for engineers using Asana as a PM tool (not just API docs).
